description: This file defines a PHP interface 'MailProcessor' within the 'OrangeHRM\Core\Mail' namespace. It declares methods for processing email templates and retrieving recipients, used as part of the OrangeHRM system's email handling functionality.

classes.name: MailProcessor
classes.description: An interface for processing emails, including retrieving replacement variables and recipients based on given parameters.

methods.name: getReplacements
methods.description: Provides replacement variables for a specified email template, given recipient info and event context.

methods.name: getRecipients
methods.description: Retrieves a list of recipients for a specified email template, based on roles and event context.
